verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a broad Marketing API covering contacts, campaign sending, account exports and a discoverable root resource, plus a Transactional API and webhooks. That covers much of the core UI workflow programmatically, but nothing claims or shows full UI parity. The webhooks guide is plan-gated to Standard/Premium. Missing for 10: any documented UI-to-API parity claim, evidence that UI features such as the drag-and-drop builder, A/B testing, predictive segmentation and generative AI features are API-accessible, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
